text.description_html:
Acorn RIZBP, Rough Iron Bean Tip Dummy Strap Hinge

These decorative bean tip dummy strap hinges give an old world charm to any cabinet without having to install working hinges. This makes them especially good to use where a working hinge would be impractical or where you already have working hinges. They are surface mounted (screwed to the door) with the included matching finish screws. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron.

Also Available: Smooth Iron Bean Tip Dummy Strap Cabinet Hinge
Click Here to see the entire Acorn Bean Tip Collection

Specifications of the Acorn 5-7/8 Inch Rough Iron Bean Tip Dummy Strap Cabinet Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 5-7/8"
  • Strap Width at Hinge End: 11/16"
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold Individually
